description: R5/S2 ratchet baseline (check-application-door-surfaces.mjs): exact value+type export surfaces of every application door (any-depth index.ts) plus the production application root-file set. Widening, shrinking, an unregistered new door/nested barrel/root barrel/root file, a deleted door, or a wildcard export (export * / export * as ns) all FAIL. Deliberate surface changes update this file in the same PR with a dated note.

notes.unconsumed-type-symbols: Five doors carry exactly one type symbol without a live door consumer (the service type): activity, financial-pulse, follow-up, cost, estimates — pinned as-is (R5 ledger §1); trimming is a surface change reserved for a later wave. parties left this list at S05 (DOC-014 / UNIT-037): its door now carries the directory surface with live door consumers.
notes.r10b-nf003-theme-preference-door-type: 2026-10-11 (R10-B3/R10B-NF-003): preferences type surface +ThemePreference — the canonical theme-preference type consumed by contexts/ThemeContext.tsx (type-only import) after deleting its local re-declaration; same-PR documented widening per PC-3.
notes.r10b-f004-capability-id-door: 2026-10-11 (R10-B3/R10A-F-004): preferences door +type CapabilityId +value isKnownCapabilityId — canonical capability-id declaration consolidated to the persistence owner; UI consumers (hook re-export, Settings) narrow explicitly instead of unsound casts; same-PR documented widening per PC-3.
notes.r10b-nf001-payment-source-door: 2026-10-12 (R10-B3/R10B-NF-001): finance door +value PAYMENT_SOURCE_UNSET +value resolveDefaultPaymentSource — the sentinel and the 0/1/multi-wallet default rule consolidated to their canonical owner application/finance/paymentSourcePolicy.ts; the UI consumer (components/finance/expenseFormModel) imports through the door per STR-615/R6 (no deep UI-to-application imports); same-PR documented widening per PC-3.
notes.r10b-nf002-inventory-unit-label-door: 2026-10-12 (R10-B3/R10B-NF-002): inventory door +value materialUnitLabel — the Arabic MaterialUnit display mapping consolidated to its canonical owner application/inventory/materialUnitLabels.ts after deleting six per-surface copies (2 application + 4 pages); the UI consumers import through the door per STR-615/R6; same-PR documented widening per PC-3.
notes.arch012-drafts-door-retirement: 2026-10-15 (R11 ARCH-012 / retirement): drafts door value surface emptied (-LEGACY_SETUP_DRAFT_KEY, -browserLegacyFormDraftStorage, -clearLegacyFormDraftStorage, -legacyFinanceDraftKey, -migrateLegacyFormDraft) — the legacy form-draft migration adapter was intentionally retired before launch by owner decision (census + decision record in docs/architecture/refactoring/r11-arch012-20261015/evidence/); type surface (FormDraftService, FormDraftValues) unchanged; documented same-PR deliberate shrink.
notes.S02-B: إعادة إرساء باب الأمن: تقاعد القفل (UNIT-042) — المقيم الوحيد تقاعد سجل القفل القديم.
notes.S02-A: إعادة إرساء باب النقل: نوعا الأمر المربوط بالمراجعة (BoundRestoreIntent/RestoreIntentContext) — بروتوكول حماية الاستبدال SH-02/SH-03.
notes.s03-offering-preference-door: 2026-10-28 (S03/DOC-012 — UNIT-038 P3.2 + UNIT-001 P3.2): preferences door +type OfferingPreference +value isOfferingPreference — the canonical offering-preference declaration owned by the preferences service (single source for the 001 setup question and the 038 usage-preferences editor); UI consumers import through the door instead of re-declaring; same-PR documented widening per PC-3.
notes.S05: 2026-10-29 (S05 / DOC-014 / UNIT-037): parties door re-anchored to the saved-party directory surface — +3 values (purchasePartySnapshotOf/salePartySnapshotOf/supplierDisplayLabelOf) and +10 types (directory service/result/store, account entry, movement kinds, save/rename/archive inputs) after retiring the name-aggregation reader (PartyLedgerOverview/PartyLedgerService removed); same-PR documented widening+shrink per PC-3.
